parameters.formDescription: Seleccione una operación. Por defecto todo corre en dry-run. El borrado es scoped por lead/conversación, borra conversaciones Chatwoot pero NO contactos, limpia memoria CRIS/LangChain/Redis y puede reenviar outbound seguro.

values.placeholder: Uno o varios teléfonos / quicklink_id separados por coma o salto de línea. Vacío si selector=marca/todos.

parameters.query:
SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS selector_type,
    $2::jsonb AS requested_values,
    NULLIF($3::text, '') AS brand,
    LEAST(GREATEST($4::int, 1), 100000) AS row_limit,
    $5::text AS action
), vals AS (
  SELECT
    value AS raw_value,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(value, '\D', '', 'g'), '') AS digits,
    CASE WHEN value ~ '^\d{1,9}$' THEN value::int END AS quicklink_id,
    CASE
      WHEN value ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN value::uuid
    END AS lead_id
  FROM params p, jsonb_array_elements_text(p.requested_values) value
), lead_norm AS (
  SELECT
    l.*,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(l.telefono_1, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '') AS phone1_digits,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(l.telefono_2, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '') AS phone2_digits,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(to_jsonb(l)->>'telefono_agente', ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '') AS agent_phone_digits
  FROM leads_quicklink l
), matching_leads AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.*
  FROM lead_norm l
  CROSS JOIN params p
  LEFT JOIN vals v ON true
  WHERE (p.brand IS NULL OR l.marca::text = p.brand)
    AND (
      p.selector_type = 'todos'
      OR p.selector_type = 'marca'
      OR (p.selector_type IN ('telefonos', 'telefono', 'phones') AND v.digits IS NOT NULL AND (
        l.phone1_digits = v.digits
        OR l.phone2_digits = v.digits
        OR l.agent_phone_digits = v.digits
        OR (length(l.phone1_digits) >= 9 AND length(v.digits) >= 9 AND right(l.phone1_digits, 9) = right(v.digits, 9))
        OR (length(l.phone2_digits) >= 9 AND length(v.digits) >= 9 AND right(l.phone2_digits, 9) = right(v.digits, 9))
        OR (length(l.agent_phone_digits) >= 9 AND length(v.digits) >= 9 AND right(l.agent_phone_digits, 9) = right(v.digits, 9))
      ))
      OR (p.selector_type IN ('quicklink_ids', 'quicklink_id', 'ids') AND v.quicklink_id IS NOT NULL AND l.quicklink_id = v.quicklink_id)
      OR (p.selector_type IN ('lead_ids', 'lead_id') AND v.lead_id IS NOT NULL AND l.id = v.lead_id)
    )
), target_leads AS (
  SELECT l.*
  FROM matching_leads l
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE p.action <> 'dispatch_only' OR l.estado_agente::text = 'PENDIENTE'
  ORDER BY l.sincronizado_at ASC NULLS LAST, l.created_at ASC NULLS LAST, l.id
  LIMIT (SELECT row_limit FROM params)
), target_phone_digits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT digits
  FROM target_leads l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (l.phone1_digits),
    (l.phone2_digits),
    (l.agent_phone_digits),
    (CASE WHEN l.phone1_digits ~ '^0\d{9}$' THEN '593' || substring(l.phone1_digits FROM 2) END),
    (CASE WHEN l.phone2_digits ~ '^0\d{9}$' THEN '593' || substring(l.phone2_digits FROM 2) END),
    (CASE WHEN l.agent_phone_digits ~ '^0\d{9}$' THEN '593' || substring(l.agent_phone_digits FROM 2) END),
    (CASE WHEN l.phone1_digits ~ '^9\d{8}$' THEN '593' || l.phone1_digits END),
    (CASE WHEN l.phone2_digits ~ '^9\d{8}$' THEN '593' || l.phone2_digits END),
    (CASE WHEN l.agent_phone_digits ~ '^9\d{8}$' THEN '593' || l.agent_phone_digits END),
    (CASE WHEN length(l.phone1_digits) >= 9 THEN right(l.phone1_digits, 9) END),
    (CASE WHEN length(l.phone2_digits) >= 9 THEN right(l.phone2_digits, 9) END),
    (CASE WHEN length(l.agent_phone_digits) >= 9 THEN right(l.agent_phone_digits, 9) END)
  ) aliases(digits)
  WHERE NULLIF(digits, '') IS NOT NULL
), target_convs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.*
  FROM conversaciones c
  JOIN target_leads l ON c.lead_id = l.id OR c.id = l.conversacion_id
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT c.*
  FROM conversaciones c
  JOIN target_phone_digits p
    ON length(p.digits) >= 9
   AND length(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(c.telefono, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '')) >= 9
   AND right(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(c.telefono, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), ''), 9) = right(p.digits, 9)
), target_mem AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lm.*
  FROM lead_memory lm
  WHERE lm.lead_id IN (SELECT id FROM target_leads)
    OR lm.conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM target_convs)
    OR (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM target_phone_digits p
        WHERE length(p.digits) >= 9
      AND length(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(lm.phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '')) >= 9
          AND right(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(lm.phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), ''), 9) = right(p.digits, 9)
      )
    )
), conv_ids AS (
  SELECT id FROM target_convs
  UNION SELECT conversation_id FROM target_mem WHERE conversation_id IS NOT NULL
), chatwoot_ids AS (
  SELECT chatwoot_conv_id FROM target_convs WHERE chatwoot_conv_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT chatwoot_conv_id FROM target_mem WHERE chatwoot_conv_id IS NOT NULL
), lead_phone_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT digits AS session_id
  FROM target_phone_digits
), session_ids AS (
  SELECT chatwoot_conv_id::text AS session_id FROM chatwoot_ids
  UNION SELECT id::text FROM conv_ids
  UNION SELECT regexp_replace(phone, '\D', '', 'g') FROM target_mem WHERE NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '') IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT session_id FROM lead_phone_sessions WHERE NULLIF(session_id, '') IS NOT NULL
), redis_keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session_id || '_buffer' AS redis_key FROM session_ids WHERE NULLIF(session_id, '') IS NOT NULL
), recent_outbound_blocks AS (
  SELECT
    d.request_id,
    b.batch_key,
    d.lead_id,
    d.quicklink_id,
    d.marca,
    d.intake_status,
    d.delivery_status,
    d.created_at,
    d.updated_at
  FROM outbound_dispatches d
  JOIN outbound_dispatch_batches b ON b.id = d.batch_id
  WHERE d.lead_id IN (SELECT id FROM target_leads)
    AND d.source = 'panel-operador'
    AND d.created_at >= now() - interval '6 hours'
    AND (
      d.intake_status = 'accepted'
      OR d.delivery_status IN ('pending', 'meta_accepted', 'sent', 'delivered', 'read')
    )
), counts AS (
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'leads', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target_leads),
    'excluded_non_pending', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matching_leads l CROSS JOIN params p WHERE p.action = 'dispatch_only' AND l.estado_agente::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'PENDIENTE'),
    'conversations', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target_convs),
    'lead_memory', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target_mem),
    'chatwoot_conversations', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chatwoot_ids),
    'redis_buffer_keys', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM redis_keys),
    'n8n_chat_histories', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n8n_chat_histories h WHERE h.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM session_ids)),
    'scheduled_followups', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduled_followups sf WHERE sf.conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM conv_ids) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_phone_digits p WHERE length(p.digits) >= 9 AND length(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(sf.phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '')) >= 9 AND right(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(sf.phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), ''), 9) = right(p.digits, 9))),
    'conversation_interactions', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_interactions ci WHERE ci.conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM conv_ids)),
    'whatsapp_interaction_events', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM whatsapp_interaction_events wie WHERE wie.conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM conv_ids) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_phone_digits p WHERE length(p.digits) >= 9 AND length(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(wie.phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '')) >= 9 AND right(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(wie.phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), ''), 9) = right(p.digits, 9))),
    'conversation_context', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_context cc WHERE cc.chatwoot_conv_id IN (SELECT chatwoot_conv_id FROM chatwoot_ids) OR cc.active_vehicle_id IN (SELECT quicklink_id FROM target_leads) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_phone_digits p WHERE length(p.digits) >= 9 AND length(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(cc.contact_phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '')) >= 9 AND right(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(cc.contact_phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), ''), 9) = right(p.digits, 9))),
    'lead_campaign_queue', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_campaign_queue q WHERE q.lead_id IN (SELECT id FROM target_leads) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_phone_digits p WHERE length(p.digits) >= 9 AND length(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(q.phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '')) >= 9 AND right(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(q.phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), ''), 9) = right(p.digits, 9))),
    'agent_decisions', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_decisions ad WHERE ad.conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM conv_ids)),
    'events', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eventos_conversacion ev WHERE ev.conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM conv_ids)),
    'handoffs', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transferencias_humano th WHERE th.conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM conv_ids) OR th.conversacion_id IN (SELECT id FROM conv_ids))
  ) AS impact
)
SELECT
  (SELECT impact FROM counts) AS impact,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'lead_id', id,
    'quicklink_id', quicklink_id,
    'marca', marca::text,
    'nombre_cliente', nombre_cliente,
    'telefono_1', telefono_1,
    'telefono_2', telefono_2,
    'telefono_agente', COALESCE(to_jsonb(target_leads)->>'telefono_agente', telefono_1),
    'modelo', modelo,
    'estado_agente', estado_agente::text
  ) ORDER BY marca::text, quicklink_id, id) FROM target_leads), '[]'::jsonb) AS leads,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT id) FROM conv_ids), '[]'::jsonb) AS conversation_ids,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT chatwoot_conv_id) FROM chatwoot_ids), '[]'::jsonb) AS chatwoot_conv_ids,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT quicklink_id) FROM target_leads), '[]'::jsonb) AS quicklink_ids,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT digits) FROM target_phone_digits WHERE NULLIF(digits, '') IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS phone_aliases,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT session_id) FROM session_ids WHERE NULLIF(session_id, '') IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS session_ids,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT redis_key) FROM redis_keys), '[]'::jsonb) AS redis_keys,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'request_id', request_id,
    'batch_key', batch_key,
    'lead_id', lead_id,
    'quicklink_id', quicklink_id,
    'marca', marca,
    'intake_status', intake_status,
    'delivery_status', delivery_status,
    'created_at', created_at,
    'updated_at', updated_at
  ) ORDER BY created_at DESC) FROM recent_outbound_blocks), '[]'::jsonb) AS recent_outbound_blocks;

parameters.query:
SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS selector_type,
    $2::jsonb AS requested_values,
    NULLIF($3::text, '') AS brand,
    NULLIF($4::text, '') AS estado,
    NULLIF($5::text, '')::date AS desde,
    NULLIF($6::text, '')::date AS hasta,
    LEAST(GREATEST($7::int, 25), 250) AS row_limit,
    GREATEST($8::int, 1) AS page_number,
    $9::text AS action,
    COALESCE($10::boolean, false) AS export_requested,
    NULLIF($11::text, '') AS lead_uuid_txt,
    COALESCE($12::boolean, false) AS query_blocked,
    10000::int AS export_limit
), vals AS (
  SELECT
    value AS raw_value,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(value, '\D', '', 'g'), '') AS digits,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(trim(value), '\s+', ' ', 'g'), '') AS text_value,
    NULLIF(translate(lower(regexp_replace(trim(value), '\s+', ' ', 'g')), 'áàäâãéèëêíìïîóòöôõúùüûñç', 'aaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuunc'), '') AS name_value,
    CASE WHEN value ~ '^\s*\d{1,9}\s*$' THEN trim(value)::int ELSE NULL END AS quicklink_id,
    CASE WHEN value ~* '^\s*[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\s*$' THEN trim(value)::uuid ELSE NULL END AS lead_id
  FROM params p, jsonb_array_elements_text(p.requested_values) value
), p AS (
  SELECT params.*,
    ((params.page_number - 1) * params.row_limit)::int AS row_offset,
    jsonb_array_length(params.requested_values) > 0 AS has_values,
    CASE WHEN params.lead_uuid_txt ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN params.lead_uuid_txt::uuid END AS lead_uuid
  FROM params
), lead_norm AS (
  SELECT
    l.id,
    l.quicklink_id,
    l.marca::text AS marca,
    l.nombre_cliente,
    l.telefono_1,
    l.telefono_2,
    COALESCE(to_jsonb(l)->>'telefono_agente', l.telefono_1) AS telefono_agente,
    l.modelo,
    to_jsonb(l)->>'agencia' AS agencia,
    to_jsonb(l)->>'ciudad' AS ciudad,
    l.estado_ql,
    l.estado_agente::text AS estado_agente,
    l.fecha_venta,
    l.fecha_asignacion,
    l.created_at,
    l.sincronizado_at,
    COALESCE((to_jsonb(l)->>'reportado_ql')::boolean, false) AS reportado_ql,
    to_jsonb(l)->>'reportado_ql_at' AS reportado_ql_at,
    c.id AS conv_id,
    c.estado::text AS estado_conv,
    c.chatwoot_conv_id,
    c.updated_at AS conv_updated_at,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(l.telefono_1, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '') AS phone1_digits,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(l.telefono_2, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '') AS phone2_digits,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(to_jsonb(l)->>'telefono_agente', l.telefono_1, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '') AS agent_phone_digits,
    NULLIF(translate(lower(regexp_replace(COALESCE(l.nombre_cliente, ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g')), 'áàäâãéèëêíìïîóòöôõúùüûñç', 'aaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuunc'), '') AS name_norm
  FROM leads_quicklink l
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.id, c.estado, c.chatwoot_conv_id, c.updated_at
    FROM conversaciones c
    WHERE c.lead_id = l.id OR c.id = l.conversacion_id
    ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
  ) c ON true
), base_total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM lead_norm
), matched AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.*
  FROM lead_norm l
  CROSS JOIN p
  LEFT JOIN vals v ON true
  WHERE NOT p.query_blocked
    AND (p.lead_uuid IS NULL OR l.id = p.lead_uuid)
    AND (p.brand IS NULL OR l.marca = p.brand)
    AND (p.estado IS NULL OR COALESCE(l.estado_agente, 'SIN_ESTADO') = p.estado)
    AND (p.desde IS NULL OR COALESCE(l.fecha_asignacion::date, l.created_at::date) >= p.desde)
    AND (p.hasta IS NULL OR COALESCE(l.fecha_asignacion::date, l.created_at::date) <= p.hasta)
    AND (
      p.lead_uuid IS NOT NULL
      OR NOT p.has_values
      OR p.selector_type IN ('todos', 'marca')
      OR (p.selector_type IN ('telefonos', 'smart') AND v.digits IS NOT NULL AND length(v.digits) >= 7 AND (
        l.phone1_digits = v.digits OR l.phone2_digits = v.digits OR l.agent_phone_digits = v.digits
        OR (length(l.phone1_digits) >= 9 AND length(v.digits) >= 9 AND right(l.phone1_digits, 9) = right(v.digits, 9))
        OR (length(l.phone2_digits) >= 9 AND length(v.digits) >= 9 AND right(l.phone2_digits, 9) = right(v.digits, 9))
        OR (length(l.agent_phone_digits) >= 9 AND length(v.digits) >= 9 AND right(l.agent_phone_digits, 9) = right(v.digits, 9))
      ))
      OR (p.selector_type IN ('quicklink_ids', 'smart') AND v.quicklink_id IS NOT NULL AND l.quicklink_id = v.quicklink_id)
      OR (p.selector_type IN ('lead_ids', 'smart') AND v.lead_id IS NOT NULL AND l.id = v.lead_id)
      OR (p.selector_type IN ('nombre', 'smart') AND v.name_value IS NOT NULL AND l.name_norm ILIKE '%' || v.name_value || '%')
    )
), limited AS (
  SELECT m.*
  FROM matched m
  ORDER BY COALESCE(m.fecha_asignacion, m.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST, m.quicklink_id DESC NULLS LAST, m.id DESC
  LIMIT (SELECT row_limit FROM p)
  OFFSET (SELECT row_offset FROM p)
), export_rows AS (
  SELECT m.*
  FROM matched m
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE p.export_requested
  ORDER BY COALESCE(m.fecha_asignacion, m.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST, m.quicklink_id DESC NULLS LAST, m.id DESC
  LIMIT (SELECT export_limit FROM p)
), kpis AS (
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'total', COUNT(*)::int,
    'pendientes', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_agente = 'PENDIENTE')::int,
    'en_gestion', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_agente = 'EN_GESTION')::int,
    'rezagados', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_agente = 'REZAGADO')::int,
    'gestion_perdida', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_agente = 'GESTION_PERDIDA')::int,
    'confirmadas_ai', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_agente = 'CONFIRMADA_AI')::int,
    'con_conversacion', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE conv_id IS NOT NULL)::int,
    'sin_conversacion', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE conv_id IS NULL)::int,
    'no_reportados_ql', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reportado_ql IS NOT TRUE)::int,
    'pendientes_30d', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado_agente = 'PENDIENTE' AND COALESCE(fecha_asignacion::date, created_at::date) <= CURRENT_DATE - 30)::int
  ) AS data
  FROM matched
), stats AS (
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'by_brand', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', marca, 'count', n) ORDER BY n DESC, marca) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(marca, 'SIN_MARCA') AS marca, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM matched GROUP BY 1) s), '[]'::jsonb),
    'by_state', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', estado, 'count', n) ORDER BY n DESC, estado) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(estado_agente, 'SIN_ESTADO') AS estado, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM matched GROUP BY 1) s), '[]'::jsonb),
    'by_conversation', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', label, 'count', n) ORDER BY n DESC, label) FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN conv_id IS NULL THEN 'SIN_CONVERSACION' ELSE 'CON_CONVERSACION' END AS label, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM matched GROUP BY 1) s), '[]'::jsonb),
    'top_models', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', modelo, 'count', n) ORDER BY n DESC, modelo) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(modelo, ''), 'SIN_MODELO') AS modelo, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM matched GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 8) s), '[]'::jsonb),
    'top_agencies', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label', agencia, 'count', n) ORDER BY n DESC, agencia) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(agencia, ''), 'SIN_AGENCIA') AS agencia, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM matched GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 8) s), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) AS data
)
SELECT
  (SELECT total FROM base_total)::int AS base_total,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched)::int AS total,
  (SELECT page_number FROM p)::int AS page,
  (SELECT row_limit FROM p)::int AS page_size,
  (SELECT row_offset FROM p)::int AS offset,
  (SELECT export_limit FROM p)::int AS export_limit,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(li.*) ORDER BY COALESCE(li.fecha_asignacion, li.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST, li.quicklink_id DESC NULLS LAST, li.id DESC) FROM limited li), '[]'::jsonb) AS leads,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(er.*) ORDER BY COALESCE(er.fecha_asignacion, er.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST, er.quicklink_id DESC NULLS LAST, er.id DESC) FROM export_rows er), '[]'::jsonb) AS export_leads,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'kpis', (SELECT data FROM kpis),
    'stats', (SELECT data FROM stats),
    'generated_at', now()
  ) AS dashboard;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    $1::boolean AS should_track,
    $2::text AS batch_key,
    $3::jsonb AS leads,
    $4::jsonb AS cleanup_counts,
    $5::jsonb AS residual_counts
), opened AS (
  SELECT o.*
  FROM (SELECT * FROM args WHERE should_track) a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL open_outbound_dispatch_batch(a.batch_key, 'panel-operador', a.leads) o
)
SELECT
  (SELECT cleanup_counts FROM args) AS cleanup_counts,
  (SELECT residual_counts FROM args) AS residual_counts,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'batch_id', batch_id,
    'batch_key', batch_key,
    'status_token', status_token,
    'dispatches', dispatches
  ) FROM opened), '{}'::jsonb) AS outbound_tracking;

parameters.query:
SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH results AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS result(
    request_id TEXT,
    status TEXT,
    "statusCode" INTEGER,
    error TEXT
  )
  WHERE request_id IS NOT NULL
    AND status IN ('accepted', 'rejected', 'failed')
), recorded AS (
  SELECT
    request_id,
    record_outbound_intake_result(
      request_id,
      COALESCE("statusCode", 0),
      status = 'accepted',
      error
    ) AS action
  FROM results
)
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'request_id', request_id,
  'action', action
) ORDER BY request_id), '[]'::jsonb) AS intake_tracking_updates
FROM recorded;
